$comment: Where the release keeps the evidence of each check that runs in CI (p1-compliance-center D3). The release-evidence job of release-please.yml (scripts/release-evidence.py) attaches each workflow's artefacts to the GitHub release as <name>.zip, and each run's logs as <workflow>-logs.zip; the Compliance Center links a CI check to its asset (compliance.ReleaseAsset). A check names its asset by its how, then by its kind; any other CI check's evidence is its run's log.
